description: Machine-tools; operated by laser or other light or photon beam processes, for working any material by removal of material

retired.note: HS 2017 subdivided 8456.10 into 8456.11 (laser) and 8456.12 (other light or photon beam). The two successors cover exactly what 8456.10 covered. Reporters filing under 8456.10 fell from 155 in 2016 to 61 in 2017, so years from 2017 are residual filings, not a world total.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.

provisional: 1 of last year's ten largest importers has not filed yet: Belgium-Luxembourg (...1998).
